facts.label: Agora e hábito
facts.sub: Use am/is/are + -ing para agora e o present simples com always, usually e never para hábitos.

facts.label: Agora
facts.sub: Para falar do que acontece agora, use am/is/are + -ing: I’m reading a book. He’s playing a game. She’s knitting. Para perguntar, use What are you doing?

facts.label: Hábitos
facts.sub: Para hábitos, use o present simples com always, usually, often ou never: I always read before dinner. She knits every evening. Com she, he e it, use -s.

facts.label: Perguntas
facts.sub: Para perguntas de agora, use Is he…? Are you…? Para hábitos, use Does he…? Do you…? Does he often play games? Depois de does, o verbo fica na forma base.

facts.label: Hora do chá
